name: Correctness
description: Is the generated result consistent with validated inputs?

name: Evidence Quality
description: Is the supporting evidence appropriate and traceable?

name: Citation Accuracy
description: Are claims correctly linked to supporting evidence?

name: Tool Selection
description: Were appropriate tools selected for the task?

name: Reasoning Path
description: Is the reasoning workflow traceable and reproducible?

name: Completeness
description: Are required evidence and decision dimensions represented?

name: Safety
description: Are human review and scientific safety controls preserved?

name: Reproducibility
description: Can the workflow be reconstructed from stored artifacts?

name: Uncertainty Calibration
description: Are uncertainty and knowledge gaps preserved?

name: Human Acceptance
description: Can a qualified reviewer inspect and approve the output?

name: Contradiction Handling
description: Are contradictions detected and preserved without unsupported resolution?

name: Decision Traceability
description: Can decision-support elements be traced to upstream evidence?

name: Latency
description: Can execution time be measured for workflow components?

name: Cost
description: Can model and tool execution cost be measured when activated?
